description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [SEO, security and site verdicts] Security headers check. Passive check of a public website's HTTPS setup: TLS version and certificate expiry, HTTP->HTTPS redirect, HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, cookie flags, version disclosure. Returns grade A+..F and fixes. ~1-3 s.

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

url.description: Website to check: a public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com

name: security_headers

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.
